note: W8 (OKNA §7.1, UI08): blocks of an assistant's answer shown in a frame with Kopiuj / Otwórz w oknie / Zapisz, opened as a window of the kind `artifact`. Everything here is a preset or an example list (CLAUDE.md): the formats, their fence words, the sniffing patterns, the file extensions, the placement, the minimum size of a block that gets a frame. A new format = an entry here; a fence word nobody listed falls to the format with the fence word "*" (code), never to nothing.
formats_note: Open list, checked in order: a fence word listed in `fence` decides; a block without a fence word is sniffed (`sniff`, a regular expression, case-insensitive); the rest is the format with "*".
ext_by_lang_note: Examples: the file extension „Zapisz” gives a code block by its fence word; an unlisted word gives the format's `ext`.
min_lines_note: A fenced block with at least this many lines gets the frame (preset 1 = every block; 0 too). Any number.
placement_note: Where „Otwórz w oknie” opens the window (float | beside | below | tab | shelf, the placements of the window model).
placements_note: Per device class, like the settings field window_placements but for artifact windows only (that field's preset sends every panel placement to maximize, the drawer of W1; an artifact is not a panel). Example: {"phone": {"float": "tab"}}. Empty = the placement as asked everywhere.
html_scripts_note: The preset of the settings field artifact_html_scripts: false = iframe sandbox without scripts. On = sandbox allow-scripts (never allow-same-origin) plus a non-blocking advisory in the window.
file_stem_note: The stem of the file name „Zapisz” proposes (then -<n>.<ext>).
